name: USPTO Patent Claims Research Dataset
publisher: United States Patent and Trademark Office, Office of the Chief Economist
temporal_coverage: US patents granted 1976-2014; US patent applications published 2001-2014
content: Parsed claim text, claim-level statistics, document-level statistics, and claim dependency relationships.
source_task: Public claim-text and structural reference corpus
annotation_status: Unlabelled source corpus. No AgentCanvas defect labels, candidate outputs, or attorney review are supplied.
intended_use: Claim segmentation and dependency parsing tests; source text for future paired evaluation examples after separate annotation.
limitations: Large download; individual claim full-text CSV is listed at approximately 4.41 GB.
The source corpus does not label generated-output defects such as omission, polarity drift, unsupported additions, or evidence mismatch.
Patent grant/application outcomes must not be treated as ground truth for claim-text defect labels.
Keep document-family members in one evaluation split to reduce leakage.
citation: Marco, Alan C., Sarnoff, Joshua D., and DeGrazia, Charles A.W. (2019). Patent claims and patent scope. Research Policy 48(9). https://doi.org/10.1016/j.respol.2019.03.015
